fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) has a 24/7 Wall St. price target of $1,209.75 pre-split (approximately $151.22 post-split), suggesting 55.85% upside from current levels over 12 months.
fields.summary_ko.1: SNDK declined 17.1% last week but is up 241.43% year-to-date, with Q1 revenue of $11.031B (exceeding consensus of $10.677B) and non-GAAP EPS of $49.51 (beating estimates of $46.27), achieving six consecutive earnings surprises.
fields.summary_ko.2: Approximately 50% of 2027 NAND bits and about two-thirds of 2028 supply are protected by long-term NBM contracts, with high-bandwidth flash launching next year and management planning to return 100% of excess cash.
